facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. The Cao Dai Temple on Đường Nguyễn Trãi is one of the most visually striking buildings on the island. Bright colors, detailed architecture, active place of worship. Free to visit. Takes 20 minutes. Most Phu Quoc itineraries skip it completely. Don't be that tourist who only sees the beach. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walk through the front gate and the colors hit you immediately. Yellows, pinks, intricate detail on every surface. Active temple, real visitors, zero crowds. This is Phu Quoc most tourists never see.
